explanation: Tests that call export builders directly, or click exports, load the QC ledger first with loadExportEvidence() (csv.test.ts at module scope, others in beforeAll). exportEvidence.test.ts covers the fail-closed accessor, the first export waiting and later ones running synchronously, contained body failures, and a failed ledger download retried by the next export. lazyChunkBoundaries pins the ledger to the two quality modules. Merged with main, whose cross-study listing and Circadian tests need no ledger load.
